# hi-document-lifecycle: guide

<!-- generated by scripts/gen-wiki-pages.mjs from SKILL.md; edit the skill, then re-run -->

> Orchestrates evidence-backed document generation, human clarification, semantic/diagram refinement, and conditional review-comment resolution with pause/resume for one scoped domain. Use hi-maintenance-docs for a complete multi-domain pack.

## Invocation

```text
/hi-document-lifecycle <domain> [generate|clarify_refine|review_update]  — one generator per run
```

## Boundaries

- Never invoke another orchestrator; leaves never update global lifecycle state.

## What the skill covers

- Inputs
- Generator Routing
- Three Phases
- Completion
